articles.title: We asked Israelis how October 7 changed their vote | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 我们问以色列人10月7日如何改变他们的投票| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Last week, Israel held a pivotal general election - the first since the deadly Hamas-led attacks on Israel on 7 October 2023 and the wars that followed in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the opposition bloc - led by Gadi Eisenkot - are in near deadlock. Now comes a period of political deal-making to form a coalition government.

The BBC’s Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson spoke to voters in the lead up to the vote to see what influenced their vote.

#Israel #Netanyahu #BBCNews

articles.title: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 美国在中期选举前袭击伊朗岛| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
The US has carried out strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, US officials have told CBS, the BBC's US partner.
 
The officials described the strikes as limited and defensive, and said they were in response to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) firing on a US aircraft.
 
Iranian state news agency Irna reported explosions on Qeshm on Monday. The IRGC did not comment but said its forces had shot down two US MQM-170 drones south of the island and a US MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.
 
The US military has not commented on the strikes, which came as mediators stepped up their efforts to prevent a return to all-out war after the US midterm elections on Tuesday.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Iran #USMidterms #BBCNews

articles.title: How AI threatens the UK's climate goals - Behind The Investigation | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 人工智能如何威胁英国的气候目标-调查背后| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Could the UK's push to become an AI superpower put its 2050 net zero target at risk?

The UK government wants to rapidly expand the number of AI data centres being built across the country, but a BBC File on 4 Investigates report has found this rapid growth could severely affect the government's own net zero climate goals. 

Plans for some of the biggest sites include proposals for on-site gas power stations to feed the energy-hungry data centres. This is because developers cannot immediately connect to the national grid - with potential waits of up to 10 years.

BBC calculations suggest that if four of these gas-fuelled mega data centres ran at full capacity all year, they could produce more carbon emissions than Manchester, Liverpool and Southampton combined.

In this episode of BBC News Behind the Investigation, Melanie Stewart-Smith talks to reporter Adrian Goldberg about the scale of the proposed new data centre sites, concerns over their potential water and energy consumption, and why developers want access to more energy than the UK's national grid can currently provide.

The government said data centres were "essential to Britain's economy" and that its new Data Centre Covenant set clear expectations for developers to pay a fair share of the costs they impose on the energy system and deliver benefits for local communities.

For more on this story, search for File on 4 Investigates on BBC Sounds or wherever you get your podcasts.

articles.readingTextZh:
英国成为人工智能超级大国的努力是否会使其2050年的净零目标面临风险？

英国政府希望迅速扩大全国范围内正在建设的人工智能数据中心的数量，但英国广播公司的一份关于4调查的文件报告发现，这种快速增长可能会严重影响政府自身的净零气候目标。

一些大型站点的计划包括现场燃气发电站的建议，以满足能源需求的数据中心。

这是因为开发商无法立即连接到国家电网-可能等待长达10年。

英国广播公司的计算表明，如果这些燃气大型数据中心中的四个全年满负荷运行，它们可能产生的碳排放量超过曼彻斯特、利物浦和南安普敦的总和。

在这一集的BBC新闻调查背后， Melanie Stewart-Smith与记者Adrian Goldberg谈到了拟议的新数据中心站点的规模，对其潜在水和能源消耗的担忧，以及为什么开发商希望获得比英国国家电网目前可以提供的更多的能源。

政府表示，数据中心“对英国经济至关重要” ，其新的数据中心公约为开发商设定了明确的期望，要求他们支付公平份额的能源系统成本，并为当地社区带来好处。

有关此故事的更多信息，请在BBC Sounds或您获取播客的任何地方搜索4 Investigates上的文件。
